Commissions.title: Every piece is born from an exchange
Commissions.intro: If you'd like to commission an artwork, this is how it works:

1.title: First conversation
1.text: Message me on WhatsApp and tell me a little about what you're looking for. You can share references, dimensions, colors, the space where the piece will live, or just a loose idea.

2.title: Proposal
2.text: Based on our conversation, we'll define the format, size, price, estimated production time and any other details of the commission.

3.title: Confirmation
3.text: Once everything is aligned, I'll send a simple document with the specifications of the piece, payment terms, deadline and shipping. Work begins after the confirmation and the down payment.

4.title: Creative process
4.text: The piece is developed from what we agreed on, while keeping my own language and process. During production, I'll share updates on how it's going.

5.title: Approval and shipping
5.text: When the piece is finished, I'll send you photos for approval. Once the final payment is confirmed, the artwork is carefully packed and shipped.

notes.1: All pieces are original and handmade;
notes.2: I don't make exact copies of images, photographs or other people's work;
notes.3: Small variations are part of the process and make each piece unique;
notes.4: Significant changes after production has started may affect the deadline and the quote;
notes.5: Production times vary depending on the size and complexity of the piece.
